title: Luxury 3 BHK Independent Floor in Sector 115, Mohali
tagline: Modern Architecture & Prime Location Near Chandigarh-Kharar Highway

location.address: Sector 115, Mohali, Near Chandigarh-Kharar Main Highway

description:
Discover contemporary living with these modern 3 BHK independent floors located in the highly desirable Sector 115, Mohali. Situated just 10 minutes away from Chandigarh and in close proximity to the Chandigarh-Kharar Main Highway, this prime residential offering combines seamlessly connected urban living with serene suburban comfort. Nestled within a secure gated society featuring expansive 45-50 ft wide RCC roads, residents will enjoy peace of mind, premium infrastructure, and easy access to over 100 branded commercial outlets nearby.

Each floor is crafted with attention to quality and durability, backed by an impressive 5-year warranty on wooden work and 1 year of dedicated after-sales service. With flexible floor choices including ground, first, and second floor options (with roof rights available), this project presents an unmatched value proposition for homeowners and investors seeking quality craftsmanship and prime location.
highlights: Prime Location in Sector 115, Mohali, 10 Minutes from Chandigarh
Secure Gated Society with 45-50 ft Wide RCC Roads
5 Years Wooden Work Warranty & 1 Year After-Sales Service
Multiple Floor Options with Roof Rights Available

title: The Glasshouse Sanctuary — Luxury 4 BHK Oceanfront Villa
tagline: Ultra-Modern Waterfront Architectural Masterpiece with Private Infinity Pool & 270° Coastal Panoramas

nearbyHighlights: Awas Golden Sand Beach (Walking distance, 2 mins)
The Boardwalk & Coastal Dining Strip (15 mins)
South Mumbai via Speedboat (20 mins direct transit)

description:
Perched gracefully along the tranquil coastline of Alibaug, The Glasshouse Sanctuary is a landmark residential estate celebrating modernist tropical architecture and seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Designed by renowned architects, the residence features soaring 16-foot floor-to-ceiling acoustic glass walls that flood the interior with natural golden-hour illumination while framing unobstructed Arabian Sea panoramas. The sprawling open-concept living pavilion connects effortlessly to a 55-foot temperature-controlled saltwater infinity pool, an outdoor teak sundeck, a sunken fire-pit lounge, and a covered alfresco dining pavilion.

The upper level houses an ultra-private master suite with dual walk-in dressing rooms, an imported Italian marble spa bathroom with a freestanding soaking tub, and a private wraparound sea-view balcony. Constructed with sustainable exposed concrete, warm Burmese teak, and smart Crestron automation throughout, this home offers the ultimate coastal lifestyle minutes from Mumbai.
highlights: 55-Ft Saltwater Temperature-Controlled Infinity Pool & Sunken Firepit
Floor-to-Ceiling 16ft Acoustic Impact Glass with 270° Sunset Vistas
Italian Marble Chef's Kitchen with Integrated Miele Appliances
Private Primary Wing with Oceanfront Balcony & Freestanding Marble Tub
Full Crestron Smart Home Automation & Dedicated Solar Backup
20 Minutes via Speedboat from Gateway of India, Mumbai
